example_summary: Computing tax for Mr. Nitin under Section 115BAC with Section 87A marginal relief.
source_provision:
### Statutory Summary Matrix: Section 115BAC & Rebate u/s 87A

| Statutory Provision | Applicability / Threshold | Core Tax Rate / Treatment | Legal Consequence / Relief Mechanism |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Section 115BAC** | Default tax regime for Individuals, HUF, AOP, BOI, Artificial Juridical Person | Concessional slab rates without specific exemptions and deductions | Option to opt out is generally not available for individuals with business income except under specified conditions |
| **Section 87A** | Resident Individuals under Section 115BAC | Rebate up to ₹ 60,000 | Available if total income does not exceed ₹ 7,00,000, subject to marginal relief provisions for incomes crossing the threshold |


> [!IMPORTANT] Marginal Relief Rule u/s 87A: When total income exceeds ₹ 12,00,000 under Section 115BAC, the income tax payable on total income exceeding ₹ 12,00,000 shall not exceed the amount of income exceeding ₹ 12,00,000.


> [!WARNING] Health and Education Cess: A mandatory cess of 4% is levied on the aggregate of income tax and applicable surcharge after allowing for rebate u/s 87A.
